disambiguation: Not just a random dice roller; it functions as a full GM emulator for solo tabletop play.
extras: The core plugin is free; Solo Oracle Pro is a one-time payment on itch. It has a detailed privacy policy stating it collects no data.
intentEvidence: A solo TTRPG oracle and GM emulator: play tabletop RPGs alone from a note, with no GM.
problem: It addresses the need for a solo player to simulate a Game Master or encounter random events while playing a tabletop RPG alone.
summary: A solo TTRPG oracle and GM emulator that allows users to play tabletop RPG scenarios alone within an Obsidian note, automatically writing results into the note.
